about: Team members MA1 prints without a stat block of their own, given one: their team's tier block with the ranks their own text states, read off the page. scripts/msh/npcs.py makes each a character of its own.
Facts only - which member, which tier, which rank changes - never the book's sentences; the member's text stays in msh_book_text.
team, member   the team's header and the member's run-in name, as printed
tier           the label of the team's block the member starts from
changes        ability letter -> the rank code the text states for it; an ability not named keeps the tier's rank
powers         [name, rank code]: a Power the text names with a rank
printed_health the member's Health where the text prints one; the build must reproduce it, which checks the method
name           the display name, where the index prints the member differently (Piper (mutate), p.66, beside the Morlock Piper, p.41)
skip           a run-in that is a cross-reference to the member's own statted entry, not a member without a block
A rank the text gives only for one power (Piper's Psyche 'in this power') changes nothing; it stays in the text.

members.skip: a cross-reference: statted in the Brotherhood of Evil Mutants, p.30
